description: Calculate Vietnamese personal income tax on a monthly taxable income that is already known (salary after compulsory insurance and family deductions), with the amount and tax of each bracket of the 5-bracket scale (5%, 10%, 20%, 30%, 35%; thresholds 10, 30, 60, 100 million VND). For non-residents: flat 20% of the income. Use gross_to_net instead when you start from a gross salary. Examples: {"taxable_income":24500000}; {"taxable_income":80000000,"as_of":"2026-03"}; {"taxable_income":50000000,"residency":"non_resident"}.

as_of.description: Date of the calculation: YYYY-MM (first day of that month) or YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in Vietnam. Supported from 2026-01; earlier dates are rejected.

date.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

month.description: Synonym of as_of (same formats: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD). Pass only one of as_of, month, date.

residency.description: Tax residency: "resident" (default; progressive scale with deductions) or "non_resident" (flat 20% of gross, no deductions).

taxable_income.description: Monthly taxable income in VND: for residents, salary after compulsory insurance and family deductions; for non-residents, the gross salary.

name: pit_only
title: Personal income tax by bracket (Vietnam)
